output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_first_completed_order_2025 FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE first_order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND first_order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: dim_customers.first_order_date is defined as the date of the first completed order (null if none), so counting customers whose first_order_date falls in 2025 answers the question. Fiscal year equals calendar year, and the half-open date range covers all of 2025. Customers with no completed orders have a null date and are excluded automatically.
